propositions: --force-close flag on rebar transition should be renamed to --force for consistency with rebar claim
The renamed --force flag must have context-dependent behavior: bypass start-work gate on open→in_progress transitions, and bypass completion-verification gate on close transitions
Unknown token --force-close (with or without value) must raise CommandError naming --force, never silently skip
All tracked doc files, tests, and code outside frozen experiment corpora must migrate to --force spelling in the same change
Bare --force on close transitions must yield (no reason given) audit reason, and --force=<reason> on open→in_progress must still prefer the reason value over --reason parameter
